note: Prose describing the grammar inside a doc comment is not a directive. A directive on the selector line mutes that rule's own declarations. A blanket disable and a directive without a reason are each violations, not mutes. Another preset's keyword still reads as a directive — the keyword is preset-scoped, and a rename that quietly stops honoring what was already written is how a signed-off reason disappears. .wf-doc is a colour-only <div>, so it gets no layout-primitive suggestion.
